This is a '''list of books about [[polyhedron|polyhedra]]'''.

==Polyhedral models==
===Cut-out kits===
*{{cite book|last1=Jenkins|first1=Gerald|last2=Bear|first2=Magdalen|title=Paper Polyhedra in Colour|year=1998|publisher=Tarquin|isbn=1-899618-23-6}} ''Advanced Polyhedra 1: The Final Stellation'', {{isbn|1-899618-61-9}}. ''Advanced Polyhedra 2: The Sixth Stellation'', {{isbn|1-899618-62-7}}. ''Advanced Polyhedra 3: The Compound of Five Cubes'', {{isbn|978-1-899618-63-7}}.<ref>{{cite journal|last=Neal|first=David|date=March 1987|issue=2|journal=Mathematics in School|jstor=30214199|page=47|title=Tarquin Polyhedra (review of ''Paper Polyhedra in Colour'')|volume=16}}</ref>
*{{cite book|last1=Jenkins|first1=Gerald|last2=Wild|first2=Anne|title=Mathematical Curiosities|year=2000|publisher=Tarquin|isbn=1-899618-35-X}} ''More Mathematical Curiosities'', Tarquin, {{isbn|1-899618-36-8}}. ''Make Shapes 1'', {{isbn|0-906212-00-6}}. ''Make Shapes 2'', {{isbn|0-906212-01-4}}.
*{{cite book|last=Smith|first=A. G.|title=Cut and Assemble 3-D Geometrical Shapes: 10 Models in Full Color|publisher=Dover|year=1986}} ''Cut and Assemble 3-D Star Shapes'', 1997. ''Easy-To-Make 3D Shapes in Full Color'', 2000.
